t: You're at the Exhibition Road Courtyard, a public courtyard that serves as an entrance to the Victoria and Albert Museum. It was completed in 2017 as part of the museum's Exhibition Road Quarter entrance and expansion. The design is by the architectural practice AL_A, the firm of Amanda Levete. Levete was a partner at Future Systems when that company won the 1999 Stirling Prize for the Lord's Media Centre, and in 2017, the year this courtyard opened, she was appointed CBE.
